description: This file implements the 'Details' feature for articles, including a query object, a validator for the query, and a handler that retrieves an article by its slug from the database, returning an envelope or throwing a not found exception.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: A record representing the request to fetch article details by slug.

classes.name: QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug provided in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query by retrieving an article from the database based on the slug, returning an envelope or throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the query to fetch article data based on slug.
